title: Reminder in error message to add model capabilities when model name does not exist
body:
> I see. Ok if you encountered issues with this in the past then it's probably best not to ignore the model capabilities. I think it could be good to produce an error message for it. 

 _Originally posted by @gabayben in [#4785](https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/4785#issuecomment-2558702505)_

linked_prs.title: Support custom models with OpenAI client
linked_prs.body:
## Why are these changes needed?

This allows custom (non-valid-OpenAI) models to be used with the OpenAI chat client, as long as the user supplies `model_capabilities`.

## Related issue number

Closes #4787

## Checks

- Added test to check things work.
- Also makes a small change to `BaseOpenAIClientConfigurationConfigModel` as suggested by pydantic to avoid `has conflict with protected namespace "model_"` warnings. Happy to revise that.

ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**  
This is an agent issue because it relates to handling model capabilities and producing error messages when a model name does not exist, which ties to LLM provider integration and the correct configuration of model parameters.
